title: Report installation plans and outcomes without exposing private data
statement: The system shall present nonmutating preliminary installation plans and distinguish blocked, planned, actual, and partial outcomes with actionable supported diagnostics while excluding private environment and credential information.

what.problem: A dry-run can be mistaken for verified installation, or an error report can expose secrets while hiding unperformed checks.
what.desired_outcome: Users can decide what an installation would affect and understand what actually happened without sensitive diagnostics or false completion.

why.rationale: Planning and honest limited results support safe user choice without manufacturing package verification or installation evidence.

conditions: When installation help, dry-run, verification, conflict handling, or actual operation results are presented.

contexts: Human-readable and structured CLI outcomes, destination planning, and bounded network diagnostics.

how.approach: Use bundled inventory for preliminary dry-run checks without downloading, extracting, or changing project files. Distinguish those checks from full verified-archive preflight and preserve existing result envelopes, exit classes, conflict and force warnings, and actual-effect reporting. Use only the declared safe network/proxy fields and closed values, without extra probes or a new proxy dispatcher.

how_much.scope: Installation's existing public result/exit contract and privacy vocabulary. Results do not claim state writes; no raw credentials, private hosts/users, headers, proxy values, or machine-local archive paths enter public diagnostics or durable generated material.

acceptance_criteria: Dry-run describes candidate destinations, potential conflicts, and explicit whole-unit replacement scope without acquisition, extraction, or project mutation; unperformed verification remains visible.
Human and structured results preserve the supported envelopes and exit distinctions and separate planned replacements from actual or partial effects.
Help and replacement results identify that local modifications inside replaced skill directories will be lost, without implying shared-parent or unrelated-state replacement.

Network diagnostics contain only allowed bounded public fields and variable names, identify uncertainty honestly, and retain verified local-archive fallback without exposing secrets or performing additional probes.
